description: Every night before the ledger checks, looks up each client’s suppliers and customers on the Australian Business Register (ABN status, GST registration, DGR status) and saves the results, so Ledger checks can run the register checks: cancelled businesses still being billed or paid, GST charged by businesses that aren’t registered, donations to non-DGR bodies, ABNs that look wrong. Each business is re-checked weekly. Also searches the register for a few suppliers with no ABN. Needs the ABR Lookup extension; publish it only if that’s installed. Reads only.

# ── bookkeeping kit: shared helpers (inlined into each node by gen-ext.js) ──
import json
import re
import datetime
import hashlib
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

# Knowledge layout. Folders may nest at most 2 levels, so inbox folders are top-level.
BK_SETTINGS = "Bookkeeping/settings.json"
BK_CLIENTS = "Bookkeeping/Clients"
BK_RULES = "Bookkeeping/Rules"
BK_BILLS = "Bookkeeping/Bills"
BK_INBOX = "Bookkeeping Inbox"
BK_PROCESSED = "Bookkeeping Processed"
BK_FAILED = "Bookkeeping Failed"
BK_MAIL = "Bookkeeping/Mail"
BK_REQUESTS = "Bookkeeping Requests"
BK_CHECKS = "Bookkeeping/Checks"
# One threshold for "needs a tax invoice / an ABN / an attachment": $75 excluding GST = $82.50 including GST.
BK_GST_INVOICE_LIMIT = 82.5


def bk_slug(name):
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", str(name or "").lower()).strip("-")
    return s[:40].strip("-") or "client"


def bk_read_json(path, default=None):
    try:
        raw = api.files.read(file=path)
    except Exception:
        return default
    try:
        return json.loads(raw)
    except Exception:
        return default


def bk_write_json(path, data):
    api.files.put(file=path, content=json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True))


def bk_tz(settings):
    # The sandbox may lack the tz database; fall back to AEST (UTC+10) rather than failing the run.
    try:
        return ZoneInfo((settings or {}).get("timezone") or "Australia/Sydney")
    except Exception:
        return datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=10))


def bk_today(settings):
    return datetime.datetime.now(bk_tz(settings)).date()


def bk_norm(name):
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9 ]+", " ", str(name or "").lower())
    s = re.sub(r"\b(pty|ltd|limited|p/l|the|inc|co)\b", " ", s)
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip()


def bk_ledger_info(ledger):
    """A ledger pack's (name, the client setting that holds the client's file in it, what that file is called, the
    client setting with its name). Xero when unset: clients and nodes from before the MYOB and QuickBooks packs are Xero's."""
    return {"myob": ("MYOB", "myob_company_file_id", "MYOB company file", "myob_file_name"),
            "quickbooks": ("QuickBooks", "qbo_company_name", "QuickBooks company", "qbo_company_name")}.get(
        str(ledger or ""), ("Xero", "xero_tenant_id", "Xero organisation", "xero_org_name"))


# ── bookkeeping kit: ledger checks (inlined into the Ledger checks nodes by gen-ext.js) ──
# The rules are ledger-neutral. They read the snapshot a ledger adapter builds (xero_ledger for Xero), so a
# Bookkeeping for MYOB or QuickBooks pack only needs its own adapter:
#   contacts  [{id, name, tax_number (digits), bank (digits; never stored), has_address, link}]
#   docs      [{id, kind: bill|invoice|bill_credit|invoice_credit, number, contact_id, contact, date, due,
#               status: draft|submitted|authorised|paid|void, total, tax, due_amount, paid_on, attachments, sent,
#               lines: [{account, tax_type, amount (ex GST), tax}], link}]
#   bank      [{id, kind: spend|receive|other (transfers, prepayments), contact_id, contact, date, total, tax, attachments, reconciled, lines, link}]
#   weekly only: accounts [{id, code, name, type, tax_type, active, pl}], tax_rates {tax_type: rate %},
#               journals [{id, date, narration, link}], org {lock_date, eoy_lock_date, settings_link},
#               balances {now, month_ago: {account id: balance}}, pl_12m {income, moved: [account ids]}
# IDs, names and default severities are the mySMB checks catalogue's (Prompt Library, Checks sheet). Urgent is
# never set automatically. Readings marked heuristic wait on the content owner's confirmation.
import secrets

CK_CATALOGUE = {
    "CHK-006": ("Contacts", "Duplicate Contact", "Medium"),
    "CHK-007": ("Contacts", "TPAR Information Missing", "Medium"),
    "CHK-008": ("Contacts", "Large GST Activity for Contact Without ABN", "Medium"),
    "CHK-017": ("Banking", "Contact Bank Account Changed", "High"),
    "CHK-018": ("Banking", "Contact Bank Account Same as Existing Supplier", "Low"),
    "CHK-021": ("Banking", "Expenses in (Month) Without Attachments Over $75", "Low"),
    "CHK-022": ("Banking", "Unreconciled Transactions Last Month", "Low"),
    "CHK-024": ("Sales", "Invoice Not Sent to Contact", "Low"),
    "CHK-028": ("Sales", "Possible Duplicate Customer Invoice", "Medium"),
    "CHK-031": ("Sales", "GST on Invoice and/or Credit Note When Not Registered", "Medium"),
    "CHK-033": ("Sales", "Invoices in Draft or Awaiting Approval", "Low"),
    "CHK-035": ("Sales", "Duplicate Invoice Paid", "Medium"),
    "CHK-055": ("Purchases", "Possible Duplicate Bill", "Medium"),
    "CHK-056": ("Purchases", "Unusual New-Supplier Payment Pattern", "Low"),
    "CHK-057": ("Purchases", "Supplier Bank Details Changed Before A Payment", "High"),
    "CHK-058": ("Purchases", "GST Claimed on a Non-Claimable Item", "Medium"),
    "CHK-059": ("Purchases", "Transaction With a GST Inconsistency", "Medium"),
    "CHK-079": ("Purchases", "Duplicate Bill Raised", "Medium"),
    "CHK-080": ("Purchases", "Duplicate Bill Paid", "Medium"),
    "CHK-086": ("Purchases", "Bills Raised Without Attachments Over $75", "Low"),
    "CHK-087": ("Purchases", "Spend Money Transaction with Like or Similar Bill", "Low"),
    "CHK-125": ("Bookkeeping", "Suspense or Uncoded Account With an Aged Balance", "Medium"),
    "CHK-129": ("Bookkeeping", "GST Account Has No GST Against It", "Medium"),
    "CHK-132": ("Bookkeeping", "Accounting System Getting Lonely", "Low"),
    "CHK-133": ("Bookkeeping", "Month-End Journals Missing", "Medium"),
    "CHK-134": ("Bookkeeping", "Lock Date Not Set", "Medium"),
    "CHK-135": ("Bookkeeping", "Lock Date Change", "Medium"),
    "CHK-136": ("Bookkeeping", "GST Registration Required", "Medium"),
    "CHK-138": ("Bookkeeping", "Inactive Account", "Low"),
    "CHK-016": ("Banking", "Batch Payment Contains Unsupported Characters", "Low"),
    "CHK-040": ("Sales", "Quotes in Draft Status", "Low"),
    "CHK-078": ("Purchases", "Bills in Draft or Awaiting Approval", "Low"),
    "CHK-093": ("Purchases", "Purchase Orders in Draft or Awaiting Approval", "Low"),
    "CHK-137": ("Bookkeeping", "Non-GST Account Has GST Against It", "Medium"),
    # Fixed asset checks: need what Asset lookups (Xero Assets) saved.
    "CHK-139": ("Bookkeeping", "Draft Fixed Asset", "Low"),
    "CHK-140": ("Bookkeeping", "Unmapped Fixed Asset Account With Balance", "Low"),
    # Register checks: need what Register lookups (ABR) saved.
    "CHK-002": ("Contacts", "Bill Attachment With a Cancelled ABN", "High"),
    "CHK-003": ("Contacts", "Business Has Incorrect GST Status", "Medium"),
    "CHK-004": ("Contacts", "Incorrect ABN for Business", "Medium"),
    "CHK-005": ("Contacts", "Matched ABN for Business", "Medium"),
    "CHK-009": ("Contacts", "Donation Against Non-DGR Entity", "Low"),
    "CHK-030": ("Sales", "Invoice Raised With a Cancelled Customer", "High"),
    "CHK-039": ("Sales", "Unpaid Income With A Cancelled Business", "High"),
    "CHK-068": ("Purchases", "GST Claimed on Multiple Bills While Not Registered for GST", "Medium"),
    "CHK-069": ("Purchases", "GST on Multiple Bank Transactions While Not Registered for GST", "Medium"),
    "CHK-071": ("Purchases", "Bill Raised With A Cancelled Supplier", "High"),
    "CHK-072": ("Purchases", "Payment to a Cancelled Supplier", "High"),
    "CHK-076": ("Purchases", "Payment to Supplier Not Registered for GST", "Medium"),
    "CHK-077": ("Purchases", "Bank Payment With GST to a Supplier Not Registered for GST", "Medium"),
    "CHK-085": ("Purchases", "Bill Raised with Supplier Not Registered for GST", "Medium"),
    "CHK-088": ("Purchases", "Expenses With a Cancelled Business", "High"),
}
# Cadence (extension owner, 14 Oct 2026): fraud and duplicate checks daily, the rest weekly.
CK_DAILY = ("CHK-006", "CHK-017", "CHK-018", "CHK-028", "CHK-035", "CHK-055", "CHK-056", "CHK-057", "CHK-079",
            "CHK-080", "CHK-087")
CK_WEEKLY = ("CHK-007", "CHK-008", "CHK-021", "CHK-022", "CHK-024", "CHK-031", "CHK-033", "CHK-058", "CHK-059",
             "CHK-086", "CHK-125", "CHK-129", "CHK-132", "CHK-133", "CHK-134", "CHK-135", "CHK-136", "CHK-138",
             "CHK-016", "CHK-040", "CHK-078", "CHK-093", "CHK-137")
# The weekly checks that read a list only they need (batch payments, quotes, purchase orders): when that list can't be
# read, the check isn't evaluated, so its open findings stay as they are instead of closing.
CK_SOURCE_CHECKS = {"batch_payments": "CHK-016", "quotes": "CHK-040", "purchase_orders": "CHK-093"}
# Weekly, and only when Asset lookups (Xero Assets) has saved results in the last fortnight.
CK_ASSETS = ("CHK-139", "CHK-140")
CK_ASSETS_DAYS = 14
# Weekly, and only when Register lookups (ABR) has saved results in the last fortnight.
CK_REGISTER = ("CHK-002", "CHK-003", "CHK-004", "CHK-005", "CHK-009", "CHK-030", "CHK-039", "CHK-068", "CHK-069",
               "CHK-071", "CHK-072", "CHK-076", "CHK-077", "CHK-085", "CHK-088")
CK_REGISTER_DAYS = 14
CK_HEURISTIC = ("CHK-003", "CHK-005", "CHK-009", "CHK-016", "CHK-056", "CHK-129", "CHK-133")
# The GST-related checks: the GST checks section of the weekly report (CRA-10 GST Check).
CK_GST = ("CHK-003", "CHK-008", "CHK-031", "CHK-058", "CHK-059", "CHK-068", "CHK-069", "CHK-076", "CHK-077", "CHK-085",
          "CHK-129", "CHK-136", "CHK-137")
# Catalogue checks a built check already covers (decision D9: merged, not built twice). A finding carries them in "also",
# so the reports count it against both IDs. CHK-073 (bill from an unknown supplier) is the intake's New supplier warning.
CK_ALSO = {"CHK-033": ("CHK-032",), "CHK-028": ("CHK-034",), "CHK-058": ("CHK-075",)}
# Resolved findings are kept this long (enough for a financial year's comparison), so reports can show what got fixed.
CK_RESOLVED_KEEP_DAYS = 400
# Findings the client has to answer (receipts, ABNs, TPAR details): the Client Queries part of the weekly report.
CK_CLIENT_QUERY = ("CHK-007", "CHK-008", "CHK-021", "CHK-086")
CK_CATEGORIES = ("Contacts", "Banking", "Sales", "Purchases", "Bookkeeping")
CK_SEVERITY_RANK = {"High": 0, "Medium": 1, "Low": 2}
CK_PRIORITY = {"High": "high", "Medium": "medium", "Low": "low"}
CK_DAILY_DAYS = 35
CK_DUP_DAYS = 7
CK_NEW_SUPPLIER_DAYS = 30
CK_NEW_SUPPLIER_LARGE = 5000.0
CK_QUICK_PAY_DAYS = 2
CK_BANK_CHANGE_DAYS = 30
CK_DUE_SOON_DAYS = 14
CK_LONELY_DAYS = 30
CK_GST_TURNOVER = 75000.0
CK_LOCK_MONTHS = 6
CK_MAX_LINES = 60
# Patterns are plain strings, used with re.search and re.sub: the Publish lint rejects compiling them.
CK_NON_CLAIMABLE = (r"(?i)\b(wages?|salar(y|ies)|superannuation|super|payg|bank (fees?|charges?)|interest|"
                    r"depreciation|amortis\w*|asic|stamp duty|fines?|penalt\w*|donations?|land tax|"
                    r"income tax|fbt|drawings|dividends?)\b")
CK_SUSPENSE = r"(?i)\b(suspense|clearing|uncoded|unallocated|holding)\b"
CK_MONTHS = r"(?i)\b(jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|sept|oct|nov|dec)[a-z]*\b"
# CHK-016 (heuristic): the characters a bank's direct-entry (ABA) file takes in a batch payment's text fields: letters,
# digits, spaces and & ' ( ) * + , - . / : ; ? @. Anything else (accents, curly quotes, #, $, %, _, emoji) is flagged.
CK_ABA_BAD = r"[^A-Za-z0-9 &'()*+,\-./:;?@]"


# ── Contacts and banking (daily) ──
# ── Duplicates, payments and new suppliers (daily) ──
# ── GST, attachments, sales and housekeeping (weekly) ──
# ── Register checks (weekly, from what Register lookups saved; skipped when there's nothing recent) ──
# ── Fixed asset checks (weekly, from what Asset lookups saved: the Xero Assets register isn't in the accounting API) ──
# ── The findings file and the client's checklist ──
# ── The client's Checks item in WorkQ: one open item per client, found by the id kept in its findings file ──


def ck_day(value):
    try:
        return datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(value)[:10])
    except Exception:
        return None


# ── bookkeeping kit: Australian Business Register adapter (inlined into register nodes by gen-ext.js) ──
# Talks to the ABR Lookup extension's `abr` connector. Only the Register lookups automation calls it, so practices
# without ABR Lookup can publish everything else; the checks read what it saves in Knowledge.
ABR_SERVER = "abr"
# Re-check a business on the register at most this often; search a name at most this often.
ABR_RECHECK_DAYS = 7
ABR_SEARCH_DAYS = 30
ABR_SEARCHES_PER_RUN = 10
# Bump when abr_best_match changes, so names searched under an older rule are searched again.
ABR_MATCH_RULE = 3
ABR_KEEP = ("found", "valid_checksum", "status", "status_from", "entity_name", "gst_registered", "gst_from", "gst_to",
            "dgr_endorsed", "acnc_registered", "error")


def abr_call(tool, **args):
    exc = None
    try:
        return api.connectors.invoke(server=ABR_SERVER, tool=tool, args=args)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise RuntimeError("ABR: " + str(exc)[:300]) from None


def abr_lookup(abns):
    """Register rows for up to 100 ABNs: {abn: {found, status, status_from, entity_name, names, gst_*, dgr_endorsed, ...}}."""
    got = abr_call("abr_lookup_abns", abns=list(abns)[:100], include_names=True)
    out = {}
    for row in (got or {}).get("results") or []:
        abn = re.sub(r"\D", "", str(row.get("abn") or ""))
        # Keep only real answers: a record, "No records found", or a bad checksum. A timeout or a register error
        # mustn't overwrite what was known (it would close real findings and lose people's ticks).
        definite = row.get("found") or row.get("error") == "No records found" or row.get("valid_checksum") is False
        if not abn or not definite:
            continue
        kept = {k: row.get(k) for k in ABR_KEEP}
        kept["names"] = [str(n) for n in (list(row.get("business_names") or []) + list(row.get("trading_names") or []))
                         if n][:6]
        out[abn] = kept
    return out


def abr_best_match(name):
    """The register's one confident match for a business name, or None: score 95+, clearly ahead of the next, and
    containing every word of the name (the register's score alone matched "Harbour IT Solutions" to
    "HARBOUR SOLUTIONS")."""
    words = set(bk_norm(name).split())
    got = abr_call("abr_search_by_name", name=str(name)[:200], active_only=True, min_score=90, max_results=10)
    rows = [r for r in (got or {}).get("results") or [] if r.get("abn") and r.get("score") is not None]
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: -float(r["score"]))
    if not rows or float(rows[0]["score"]) < 95:
        return None
    # Ambiguous across everything the register returned (another business scoring about as high), not just the
    # results that pass the word check: filtering first turned a close call into a confident-looking match.
    if len(rows) > 1 and float(rows[1]["score"]) >= float(rows[0]["score"]) - 2 and rows[1]["abn"] != rows[0]["abn"]:
        return None
    if not words or not words <= set(bk_norm(rows[0].get("name")).split()):
        return None
    return {"abn": re.sub(r"\D", "", str(rows[0]["abn"])), "name": rows[0].get("name") or "", "score": rows[0]["score"]}


# ── Look up the register ──


import time

started = time.monotonic()
# Stay well inside the 20-minute run limit; the next run carries on with whatever is left.
BUDGET_SECONDS = 13 * 60
settings = bk_read_json(BK_SETTINGS)
wanted = bk_slug(params.get("client_name")) if params.get("client_name") else ""
summary = {"clients": [], "looked_up": 0, "searched": 0, "left": 0, "errors": []}
problem = ""

if not settings:
    problem = "Bookkeeping isn't set up yet. Run **Bookkeeping: Start setup** and submit the Bookkeeping setup form."
else:
    today = bk_today(settings)
    for f in api.files.list(path=BK_CLIENTS):
        client = bk_read_json(f["path"]) if str(f.get("name") or "").endswith(".json") else None
        # Only the clients of this pack's ledger (Xero when the node has no ledger param).
        if not client or not client.get(bk_ledger_info(params.get("ledger"))[1]) or client.get("checks_enabled", True) is False:
            continue
        slug = client.get("slug") or ""
        if wanted and wanted != slug and wanted != bk_slug(client.get("name")):
            continue
        state = bk_read_json(BK_CHECKS + "/" + slug + ".json") or {}
        register = (state.get("snapshot") or {}).get("register") or {}
        intake = bk_read_json(BK_CHECKS + "/" + slug + "-intake.json") or {}
        # Every ABN the checks need: the client's contacts (saved by Ledger checks) and those read off bill PDFs.
        abns = set(register.get("abns") or [])
        for seen in (intake.get("abns") or {}).values():
            abns.update(a for a in seen or [] if len(a) == 11)
        path = BK_CHECKS + "/" + slug + "-abr.json"
        cache = bk_read_json(path) or {}
        rows = cache.setdefault("abns", {})
        names = cache.setdefault("names", {})
        stale = sorted(a for a in abns if not rows.get(a)
                       or (today - (ck_day(rows[a].get("checked")) or today - datetime.timedelta(days=999))).days >= ABR_RECHECK_DAYS)
        done = 0
        failed = False
        exc = None
        try:
            for i in range(0, len(stale), 100):
                if time.monotonic() - started > BUDGET_SECONDS:
                    summary["left"] += len(stale) - i
                    break
                for abn, row in abr_lookup(stale[i:i + 100]).items():
                    row["checked"] = str(today)
                    rows[abn] = row
                    done += 1
            searches = 0
            for name in register.get("no_abn") or []:
                key = bk_norm(name)
                last = ck_day((names.get(key) or {}).get("checked"))
                same_rule = (names.get(key) or {}).get("rule") == ABR_MATCH_RULE
                if not key or (last and same_rule and (today - last).days < ABR_SEARCH_DAYS):
                    continue
                if searches >= ABR_SEARCHES_PER_RUN or time.monotonic() - started > BUDGET_SECONDS:
                    break
                names[key] = {"name": name, "checked": str(today), "match": abr_best_match(name), "rule": ABR_MATCH_RULE}
                searches += 1
            summary["searched"] += searches
        except Exception as exc:
            failed = True
            summary["errors"].append(str(client.get("name")) + ": " + str(exc)[:300])
        # Forget ABNs and names the client no longer needs, so the file doesn't grow for ever.
        for abn in list(rows):
            if abn not in abns:
                rows.pop(abn)
        current = {bk_norm(n) for n in register.get("no_abn") or []}
        for key in list(names):
            if key not in current:
                names.pop(key)
        # "Fresh" only when this run reached the register (or had nothing to look up): Ledger checks stops trusting
        # the file a fortnight after the last good run.
        if not failed and (done or not stale):
            cache["refreshed"] = str(today)
        bk_write_json(path, cache)
        summary["looked_up"] += done
        summary["clients"].append({"client": client.get("name"), "abns": len(abns), "looked_up": done})
    if wanted and not summary["clients"]:
        problem = "No client with ledger checks turned on matches \"" + str(params.get("client_name")) + "\"."
